# TechMind

Website: https://techmind.it.com/

TechMind builds AI sales assistants that answer fast, qualify leads, book appointments, and follow up — with your team in control. TechMind provides business-focused AI sales assistants and automation services, including lead qualification, appointment booking, CRM workflows, and human-reviewed follow-up.

Contact: call TechMind Solutions at 408-624-8411, or book a free AI strategy call at https://techmind.it.com/packages.html#inquiry

## Packages (all Custom quote)

- Focus — 1 AI sales agent
- Team — 2 AI sales agents
- Department — 3 AI sales agents
- Operations — 4–6 AI sales agents
- Enterprise AI Team — 7–10 AI sales agents

Add-ons: voice reception, cybersecurity, custom automation. Pricing is customized after a consultation and written scope. Hosting, model usage and third-party services are scoped separately.

## Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

AEO gets a business quoted and cited by AI answers — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot and Gemini. TechMind's AEO package includes AI crawler access, sitemap, llms.txt, structured data/schema, answer-first pages, and citation tracking and reporting. No citation, ranking or placement is guaranteed — the engines decide.

## Questions owners ask

- What does TechMind do? TechMind builds AI sales assistants that answer fast, qualify leads, book appointments, and follow up — with your team in control. Start with one agent and scale to a ten-agent Enterprise AI Team.
- How many AI agents should I start with? Start with one agent (Focus), then expand to Team (2), Department (3), Operations (4–6), or Enterprise AI Team (7–10).
- What is AEO and how is it different from SEO? SEO helps you rank in search results. AEO helps AI engines quote and cite your business in their answers.
- How much does TechMind cost? Every package is a custom quote, priced after a consultation and written scope.
- How do I get started? Book a free AI strategy call, or call 408-624-8411.
